heroHeadline: Afghanistan Confirms 28 Dead Fighters Came from Pakistan; Islamabad Denies Government Ties
heroSubtitle: Afghanistan officially stated September 27 that the 28 fighters killed in recent cross-border clashes came from Pakistan, while Islamabad denied any government ties to the armed group. The exchange marks a diplomatic escalation as both governments trade conflicting accounts of the incident. It follows Pakistani forces killing several Afghan Taliban fighters in the Gulistan sector of Balochistan on September 25 after an attempted border incursion, and Pakistan's September 24 airstrikes on 10 sites in Kandahar, Paktia and Khost — which Afghan officials said killed four civilians. Taliban spokesman Zabihullah Mujahid had warned of an 'appropriate response' to those strikes. No formal ceasefire or new Urumqi round has been confirmed.
